nodes.description: McdGenerate.executeAction: parses calldata, applies param mapping and calls _mcdGenerate, returns amount as bytes32
McdGenerate.executeActionDirect: single-action entrypoint that parses inputs and calls _mcdGenerate directly
McdGenerate.actionType: pure function returning STANDARD_ACTION
McdGenerate._mcdGenerate: drips the jug, frobs the vault, moves dai, hopes DAI join and exits dai to recipient
McdGenerate.parseInputs: abi.decodes callData into vaultId, amount, to and mcdManager
Constant address of the MakerDAO Jug used to drip the ilk stability fee
Constant ISpotter instance used for Maker price/mat queries
Constant IVat instance (McdHelper) used for dai balance, can() and hope() calls
AdminVault constant storing owner and admin used by onlyOwner/onlyAdmin modifiers
External caller address, used for authorization checks and logger attribution
Current block timestamp used by the registry timelock logic
External call mcdManager.frob(vaultId, 0, dart) that generates extra dai debt
External call IDaiJoin(DAI_JOIN_ADDR).exit(_to, _amount) that transfers dai out to an arbitrary recipient
External call to DefisaverLogger.Log emitting the action event
External call vat.hope(DAI_JOIN_ADDR) granting vat allowance to the dai join
DFSRegistry.startContractChange: records block.timestamp as changeStartTime for a pending contract change
DFSRegistry.approveContractChange: validates that block.timestamp passed the wait period before swapping addresses
bytes[] _callData parameter of executeAction containing encoded action inputs
bytes[] _subData parameter of executeAction holding subscribed values
uint8[] _paramMapping parameter of executeAction selecting return/sub injection
bytes32[] _returnValues parameter of executeAction holding previous action returns
Local vault id decoded and param-mapped inside executeAction
Local dai amount decoded, param-mapped and returned by executeAction
Local recipient address decoded and param-mapped inside executeAction
Local MakerDAO manager address used by executeAction
uint256 _vaultId parameter of _mcdGenerate identifying the Maker vault
uint256 _amount parameter of _mcdGenerate, amount of dai to generate and send
address _to parameter of _mcdGenerate, dai recipient passed to exit
address _mcdManager parameter of _mcdGenerate, cast to IManager for external calls
Local stability fee rate obtained from IJug.drip inside _mcdGenerate
Local vat dai balance of the urn read inside _mcdGenerate
Local vaultId decoded from _callData[0] inside parseInputs
Local amount decoded from _callData[1] inside parseInputs
Local to address decoded from _callData[2] inside parseInputs
Local mcdManager address decoded from _callData[3] inside parseInputs

_subData parameter is consumed by executeAction param mapping
_paramMapping parameter controls which inputs executeAction replaces
_returnValues parameter is injected into actions before _mcdGenerate
executeAction calls parseInputs to decode _callData
parseInputs returns vaultId which is stored in local cdpId
parseInputs returns amount which is stored in local amount
parseInputs returns to address which is stored in local to
parseInputs returns mcdManager address which is stored in local mcdManager
cdpId from executeAction is passed as _vaultId into _mcdGenerate
amount from executeAction is passed as _amount into _mcdGenerate
to address from executeAction is passed as _to into _mcdGenerate
mcdManager address from executeAction is passed as _mcdManager into _mcdGenerate
executeAction invokes _mcdGenerate then encodes the returned amount
executeActionDirect calls parseInputs on the supplied _callData
executeActionDirect invokes _mcdGenerate for the single action path
_callData array elements are abi.decoded by parseInputs
parseInputs decodes _callData[0] into local vaultId
parseInputs decodes _callData[1] into local amount
parseInputs decodes _callData[2] into local to address
parseInputs decodes _callData[3] into local mcdManager address
_vaultId is used as the cdp id argument of the external frob call
_amount is normalised into the dart argument of the external frob call
_mcdManager controls which external contract is invoked via frob
_mcdGenerate performs the mcdManager.frob external call
_mcdGenerate conditionally performs vat.hope(DAI_JOIN_ADDR)
_mcdGenerate performs the IDaiJoin.exit external transfer call
_amount is the dai amount forwarded to the recipient by exit
_to is the arbitrary recipient address supplied to the external exit call
msg.sender is written into the logger event as the caller
_mcdGenerate calls the external logger contract at the end of the action
exit sends dai to the attacker-controlled _to address while _mcdGenerate state/logging is still in progress, enabling reentrancy

msg.sender is referenced inside _mcdGenerate for the logger call
JUG_ADDRESS is used by _mcdGenerate to call IJug.drip
vat constant is read for dai balance and can() checks inside _mcdGenerate

block.timestamp is stored as changeStartTime, making the timelock dependent on miner-controllable time
block.timestamp is compared against changeStartTime plus waitPeriod to approve a contract change

adminVault.owner() is queried by the onlyOwner modifier on startContractChange
adminVault.owner() is queried by the onlyOwner modifier on approveContractChange
